worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes; 'auto' scales to number of CPU cores.

error_log_path.description: Path for the error log file.

error_log_level.description: Error log verbosity level (debug, info, notice, warn, error, crit, alert, emerg).

worker_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections each worker can handle.

nginx_conf_dir.description: Base directory for NGINX configuration (used to locate mime.types).

access_log_path.description: Path to the access log file (uses 'zipkin' format).

keepalive_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for keep-alive connections to upstream servers.

keepalive_requests.description: Maximum number of requests served per keep-alive connection.

gzip_compression_level.description: Gzip compression level (1–9); higher = more CPU but smaller payloads.

gzip_types.description: MIME types to compress with Gzip.

server_listen_port.description: Port to listen on for incoming HTTP traffic.

server_name.description: Server name (hostname or wildcard) to respond to (SNI-aware).

ssl_certificate_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (only used if SSL enabled).

ssl_certificate_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file (only used if SSL enabled).

ssl_ciphers.description: SSL cipher suites to allow (strong defaults; avoid weak ciphers).

upstream_servers.description: List of backend servers for upstream load balancing.

upstream_keepalive_connections.description: Maximum number of idle keep-alive connections to upstream servers.

proxy_connect_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) to establish connection to upstream.

proxy_send_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for transmitting request to upstream.

proxy_read_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for reading response from upstream.
